{
  "name": "game-casting",
  "displayName": "GAME MODE · Casting",
  "version": "0.2.0",
  "description": "The spinner while a turn runs: CASTING · what runs now · 행동 n · G +the turn's cost so far, with the engine's own time and tokens after it",
  "author": {
    "name": "Reason of Moon",
    "url": "https://github.com/Reasonofmoon"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/Reasonofmoon/bitgame-mods/tree/main/plugins/game-casting",
  "repository": "https://github.com/Reasonofmoon/bitgame-mods",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "mod",
    "game-mode",
    "spinner",
    "progress",
    "cost"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "intensity": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Intensity",
      "description": "off leaves the spinner to the engine; casual names the running call, the actions and the cost; hardcore adds how many calls run at once",
      "default": "casual",
      "options": [
        "off",
        "casual",
        "hardcore"
      ]
    },
    "currency": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Currency",
      "description": "krw converts the cost ledger with krwPerUsd; usd shows it as kept",
      "default": "krw",
      "options": [
        "usd",
        "krw"
      ]
    },
    "krwPerUsd": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "KRW per USD",
      "description": "Rate used when currency is krw",
      "default": 1400,
      "min": 1,
      "max": 100000
    }
  }
}
